action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate tau_filter first (must be float, not bool, finite, nonnegative)
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Validate inputs: each must be a 2D numpy array, non-empty, finite, nonpositive
    mat_list = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    for mat in mat_list:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be a numpy array")
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be a 2D matrix")
        if mat.shape[0] == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError("All log-probability entries must be finite")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError("All log-probability entries must be nonpositive")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted loss for each set of log probabilities
    loss_with_result = -logp_with_result @ weights
    loss_call_only = -logp_call_only @ weights
    loss_no_call = -logp_no_call @ weights

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline: min of empty and call-only
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold decision
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
